annotations.title: Rank postcode districts by published crime rate

description:
Postcode districts in England and Wales ranked by published street-crime records,
    anti-social behaviour included, per 1,000 Census 2021 residents. Each row has the rate, the
    counts behind it, and its page_url. These are published rates, not safety ratings.
